A '''[[Species/Legends|species]]''' was found in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="AOTC" /> [[Chon Actrion/Legends|Chon Actrion]] was a member of this species.<ref name="TVD" />

==Biology and appearance==
A [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], they possessed large heads, with upturned [[Nose/Legends|nostrils]] and wide crests.<ref name="AOTC" />

==Species in the galaxy==
One member of this species, [[Chon Actrion/Legends|Chon Actrion]],<ref name="TVD" /> was a renowned [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] at some point in the history of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|10|Actrion, Chon}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ChonActrionMaquette-AOTC.png|thumb|right|200px|This species' original maquette.]]
This species could first be seen briefly via a bust in the background of {{Film|II}},<ref name="AOTC" /> later shown better in sources like the [[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]].<ref name="Card">[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game|''Star Wars Galaxies'' Trading Card Game]]</ref> This design was originally created as a maquette bust by [[John Knoll]] and team,<ref name="FPtP">{{HomeVideoCite|film=2|featurette=From Puppets to Pixels: Digital Characters in Episode II}}</ref> including [[Robert E. Barnes]],<ref name="Barnes">{{WebCite|url=http://www.robertebarnesdesign.com/portfolio.html|text=Robert E Barnes Design|work=[http://www.robertebarnesdesign.com Robert E Barnes Design]|archivedate=20251013210905}}</ref> to serve as a potential design for the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], presented alongside twenty-three other species sculptures for [[George Lucas]] to choose from. Lucas would request to combine the crest of this species and the face of another to better accommodate his vision,<ref name="FPtP" /> though alongside a handful of the unselected species maquettes, this full design would be recycled for some of the busts to fill the Jedi Archives,<ref name="AOTC" /> being the only one whose character received a name.<ref name="TVD">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
